strategy.observation: Nine of Duolingo’s most popular language courses reached B2 in 2026 as AI helped expand its course offerings.
strategy.offer_link: If some B2 lessons call for nuanced conversational audio, the sender could provide voice actors and production for those specific lessons, giving the Director of Learning Content a human-recorded option alongside AI-assisted course expansion.
hypotheses: Some B2 lessons may benefit from human performances that demonstrate conversational pacing, emphasis, and emotional nuance.
Duolingo may consider external audio partners for selected content rather than producing every recording internally.
The Director of Learning Content may influence audio requirements and production partner selection.
strategy.angle: With nine Duolingo language courses reaching B2 this year, would human-recorded dialogue be useful for selected lessons focused on conversational nuance?
strategy.fit_reason: Voice acting and audio production have a plausible application in higher-level language-learning content and are relevant to this recipient’s role, although the facts do not establish a need for external production or a preference for human voices.

draft.subject: B2 dialogue audio
draft.body:
With nine of Duolingo’s most popular language courses reaching B2 this year, some lessons probably need more than synthetic voices.

I help with voice actors and audio production for language-learning content, mainly where pacing, emphasis, and conversational nuance matter. If you’re lining up selected B2 dialogue for human recording alongside AI-assisted content, who handles audio requirements on your side?
